notes.note: #3667 Fix round 5: Reviewed the narrow composeRequestSignals delta against the affected transport, cancellation, deadline and ownership claims. Native AbortSignal.any owns abort ordering where available without manual composition listeners; iOS 16.4 retains the listener fallback, which selects the first observed aborted input in composition order and cannot recover chronological order under reentrancy. Documented request budgets, five-minute cap, Request/init cancellation and SDK ownership remain accurate, so no prose change is needed. Focused tests passed 231/231 including reviewer matrices and real approximately 41-second HTTP read. Restoring round-4 source on committed clean 706edef1bf1 caused precisely two first-reason regressions; restoration passed 35/35. SSE retry composition is untouched; no physical-device or hosted completion claim.
